notes.title: 0.1.2a) Quadrant 4 Added
notes.notes:
Patch contents


Added Quadrant 4

Fixed a minor UI glitch in the in-game menu (no functional change)

Fixed unintended breach effect flicker at the end of a round

Added several small maps to Quadrants 1 & 2

Enabled travel between specific nodes within each quadrant; the links are visually indicated

notes.notes:
Patch contents

Fixed several incorrect Rana's trait values

Fixed the issue that Rana's traits counting stat-reward tokens as items

Tweaked the item pools in Quadrant 1 maps

Fixed an issue where a certain boss round did not function properly

notes.title: 0.1.1a) New Character & Visual Feedback
notes.notes:
Patch contents:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRv9H0sG/rana-pick.png[/img]
New character Rana
-Has multiple unique traits that interact with the number of items in the inventory

Fixed a typo in the save/load code that could prevent saves from loading correctly

Fixed bug where trait data was not being saved

Fixed error that occurred when downgrading a trait

Fixed intermittent malfunction of item highlight

notes.title: 0.1.0a) Stat Window · Character Select · Boss Added, etc.
notes.notes:
Long time no see.


Patch contents:

Added stat display window graphics.

Added multiple new items.

Added R-key binding (rotate item).

Tweaked several terms/sentences in the Japanese localization.

Implemented character-select screen (slots + preview).

-The new character is complete but still in internal testing; it will be enabled later this week.

Fixed Piercing stat not applying.

Added Traits.

Fixed error when combining three items.

Fixed bug where item rewards were not granted even with empty inventory slots.

Fixed boss-HP UI display error.

Added a new boss.

Cleaned up Quadrant 1 maps, item rewards, and monster tables.

Rebalanced the Crystal Staff item line.

Added new enemy movement patterns.

Adjusted item prices.


Next patch:

Add the new character, blueprints, and Quadrant 4 maps

[*] Key Mapping (Completed)

[*] Completion of Quadrant 1 (Addition of two bosses) <- At this point, the game version will be 0.0.2. 
[/list]

We had planned to add one blueprint and one character in February and complete Quadrant 1, but that did not work out. It is expected that Quadrant 1 will be completed by next Wednesday.

The new character's sprites are completed, and we are working on the perks. The new blueprint is not yet public, but we are adding it while testing new item functionalities.

At this pace, the parts we planned to complete in February will likely be finished around March 8.

As an aside, I just realized that I must have written the year 2024 in the announcement all along.
Oh no...

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Map Additions, Item Reward Adjustments, etc.
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

-Two new maps have been added to Quadrant 1. The enemy compositions in these two maps are temporary and will be revised in the next patch.

-Added missing item descriptions.

-Adjusted item rewards.


Currently Identified Bugs:

-We have found an occasional bug where item rewards or trade transactions sometimes fail to grant items. We are investigating the conditions that cause this issue. For now, if this bug occurs, moving an existing item somewhere within your inventory should allow you to receive the reward normally. We wanted to fix this in this patch, but we were unable to do so. We apologize for the inconvenience.

-There is a bug where, if the inventory is full during item crafting, the crafted item gets ejected out of the inventory.


Next Patch (Next Wednesday (2025.02.26 PST)):

-Massive map additions for Quadrant 1

-Addition of new enemy types

-Adding environmental hazards (obstacles other than enemies) to maps

-Addition of one new boss


Planned Updates for February:

-Resolution settings in Options (Completed)

-FPS settings in Options (Completed)

-Key Mapping (Completed)

-Adding new items to default blueprints (In Progress)

-Completion of Quadrant 1 (addition of two bosses) <- At this point, the game version will be 0.0.2.

-Addition of new blueprints

-Addition of new characters

Frankly, the additions of blueprints and characters will probably not be completed within this month.


Thank you.

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Perk Additions, Enemy Attack Type Additions, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

-The character selection screen has been added to the main menu, but it is not yet functional. We hope to activate it before the end of the month.

-The final remaining perk has been added, completing the default character’s perks (total 19 perks).

-New enemy ranged attack types have been implemented:
The red attack now is affected by Defense, while the new blue attack is affected by Resistance.

-The visibility of Auras has been adjusted.

-Fixed an issue where Auras were not fully applied; it seems some code was left unfinished in the previous patch.

-The Slime Stick now has an Aura that slows down enemy projectile speed.

-Tooltip visibility has been improved.

-Fixed an issue with ranged weapons where the attack count was not applied.

-Two new maps have been added to Quadrant 1. The enemy composition in these maps is temporary and will be revised in the next patch.


Bug Fixes:

-Fixed an issue from the previous patch: items that provided additional HP or ST increased only the maximum values at the start of a round, leaving the current HP/ST unchanged. This fix now works as intended.

-Fixed a bug that made progression impossible beyond the second map; this was resolved on Monday (2025.02.17).

-Fixed problems with translations malfunctioning.


Known Issues:

-There is an intermittent bug where item rewards or trade transactions sometimes fail to grant items. We are investigating the conditions causing this issue. In the meantime, moving an existing item within your inventory should allow you to receive the reward normally.
We aim to fix this by this Saturday (2025.02.22), though the root cause is not fully identified yet. Your patience is appreciated.

-There is a bug where if the inventory is full during item crafting, the crafted item is ejected outside of the inventory.


Next Patch (This Saturday, 2024.02.22):

-Further expansion of the Quadrant 1 map.

-Addition of new enemy types.

-Adding environmental hazards to maps (lower priority).


Planned Updates for February:

Resolution settings in Options ✅ (Completed)
FPS settings in Options ✅ (Completed)
Key Mapping ✅ (Completed)

Adding new items to default blueprints (In Progress)

Completion of Quadrant 1 (adding two bosses) ← At that point, the game version will be 0.0.2.
Addition of new blueprints.
Addition of new characters.


Thank you!

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Perk Additions, Temporary Items Completed, Bug Fixes, and More
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

-Item descriptions, sprites, and translations have been added for Gloves of Swiftness, Crystal Cape, and Cowl of Illusion.

-The Frozen Armor effect has been implemented.

-New perks for the default character have been added.


Bug Fixes:

-Fixed an issue where items that provide additional HP or ST would increase maximum HP/ST at the start of a round, but current HP/ST remained the same.

-Although it was not technically a bug, repeatedly acquiring the same World Core from a single map has been disabled.
Now, once the boss has been defeated, you cannot re-enter that map.
More bosses will be added soon, so we ask for your patience until then.


Known Issues:

There is an occasional bug where item rewards or trade transactions fail to grant items.
We are investigating the conditions that cause this issue. For now, if this happens, try moving an existing item inside your inventory—this should allow you to receive the reward properly.
We will try to fix this by next Saturday at the latest.


Next Patch (Next Wednesday, 2025.02.19):

-Further expansion of Quadrant 1 map

-Final perk addition for the default character (Only one left!)

-Additional damage types for enemy projectiles

-Fixing the issue where attack count does not apply to ranged weapons

-Adding environmental hazards to maps

Thank you!

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Added Discard Item Function and More
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

-You can now discard items from your inventory.
-If your inventory is full, you will no longer be able to receive rewards or trade items. You must discard or sell items to make space. This change addresses a previous issue that could cause soft-lock situations.

[b]
Next Patch:[/b]

-The perk update originally scheduled for next Tuesday will now be combined with the dialogue addition patch. In other words, next Friday, perks, partial work on Quadrant 1, and additional dialogue content will all be included in a single update.


[b]Known Issue:[/b]

-Occasionally, item recognition fails during crafting, but moving the items or the target crafting items within the inventory resolves the issue temporarily. The cause has been identified, and we will patch this as soon as it’s fixed.


Thank you!
